SENSORIUM. [2] [Berb.]
Vertigo and dizziness in head.
Feeling of drunkenness, dizziness, vacuity, confusion, heaviness in head, especially in front, with pressure in sinciput, attended with alternating chilliness and heat from morning till afternoon, succeeded by a nasal flux and sneezing, as if catarrh would arise, but which does not appear.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Berb.]
Tearing pain in whole head, now here, now there, in forehead and temples.
A peculiar cold sensation in right temple.
A puffy sensation in whole head.
A feeling in head as if it was becoming larger.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Berb.]
Violent shooting pains through eyes into brain, or from temples to eyes ; sometimes into arms, or from knee to eye. θ After operation for strabismus.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Berb.]
Shooting behind right ear in attacks, < every evening.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Berb.]
Dryness of nose. θ Epistaxis.
The nose and eyes moist, with sneezing, as if catarrh was commencing.
Chronic coryza on left side, pains extending to Highmorian cavity.
Purulent yellow or greenish discharge. θ Coryza.
Obstinate catarrh of left nostril, with secretion, first of yellow water, later purulent white, yellow or green mucus ; empyreumatic smell and taste, particularly in morning.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Berb.]
Pains extending into Highmorian cavity ; left side. θ Coryza.
Pale, earthy complexion, with sunken cheeks and hollow, blue encircled eyes. θ Fistula in ano.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Berb.]
Gums bleed easily.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Berb.]
Slimy furred tongue. θ Hemorrhoids.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Berb.]
Saliva sticky, like soapsuds.
Sticky, frothy saliva, like cotton.
Aphthæ.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Berb.]
Great thirst, alternating with aversion to all kinds of drinks. θ Jaundice.
Want of appetite. θ Hemorrhoids.
Canine hunger, alternating with loathing of food. θ Jaundice.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Berb.]
Eructations without bad taste, or smell.
Frequent belching. θ Hemorrhoids.
Bilious eructations.
Violent heartburn.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Berb.]
Pressure in stomach. θ Hemorrhoids.
Violent stinging, burning, peculiar pain in stomach, similar to heartburn, but much worse, also extending upward into œsophagus.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Berb.]
Diseases of liver.
In hypochondriac region, near border of false ribs, about three inches from linea alba, violent sticking pains for a quarter of an hour, increased by pressure, extending across into region of stomach.
Sticking, pressive pain in region of liver, increased by pressure, corresponding to region of gall-bladder, on a small spot, coming on spasmodically.
Colic from gall-stones.
Bilious colic, followed by jaundice.
At a point about midway between right ant. sup. spinous process of ileum and umbilicus, a sudden, sharp, severe pain, often extending towards groin, sometimes extending upward to right hypochondrium, exceedingly severe, lasting three to twelve seconds, coming frequently induced by exercise, e. g., walking, and more frequent and more severe the greater the amount of exercise ; the day before the prescription was made, he had had thirty or forty attacks, having walked and stood a great deal.
Violent stabbing pain in region of liver took his breath, had to bend over.
Sharp, pinching pains in liver, which come suddenly and with great severity ; at times caused him to hold his breath, to bend over and to get red in face ; pink sediment in urine ; feces black, or very dark, very adhesive to commode ; frequent urging to urinate ; feces scanty, requiring an effort to expel.
Pressure in left hypochondrium, backward, drawing downward.
Contracting, forcing sensation in left abdomen, upper part, < in left hypochondrium towards navel.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Berb.]
Constant troublesome bloatedness of abdomen, with occasional forcible and noisy discharges of flatus. θ Jaundice.
Pain in region about three inches to side of navel, corresponding to a place in front of kidneys, and rather to sides, mostly sticking, often extending to lumbar region or to groins, liver, spleen, or stomach.
Burning, smarting pain in right inguinal fold, with tension on motion.
In right inguinal region near abdominal ring, some varicose veins.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Berb.]
Constant feeling as though she must go to stool.
Looseness, with viscous slime. θ Hemorrhoids.
Several copious, thick mushy stools.
Diarrhœa ; mush-like yellowish discharges, with rumbling and passing of wind ; squeamishness, much thirst ; heat in face, and dulness of head ; afterwards in evening, increased appetite.
Clay-colored stools ; occasional pain in big toe and leg, up to shoulder ; sometimes pain in bladder ; urine scalds.
Changing stool, irregular, costive or loose. θ Hemorrhoids.
Constipation.
Intense pain before and with stool, as from constriction in rectum, preventing passage of feces.
Burning, stitching pain during, before and after stool.
A long-continued sensation after stool, as if one had just been to stool, or as if one had just recovered from a pain in anus.
Painful pressure in perineum ; stitches in perineum, expending deep into (l. side) pelvis. θ Fistula in ano.
Smarting pain in anus.
Tearing extending around anus.
Herpes around anus.
Fistula in ano, with itching there ; short cough and chest complaints.
Fistula since two or three months, with a troublesome short cough and morbid appearance ; after Berb. 18 cent., cough ceased in forty-eight hours, fistula improved for two weeks ; then a biliary colic which he had not had for three years, but frequently before (Coloc.) ; fistula improving ; furuncle appeared for several weeks ; a kind of tetter on edge of anus remained.
Fistula recti when attended with bilious symptoms.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Berb.]
Pressive or tensive pain in region of loins and kidneys, sometimes on one side, sometimes on both or frequently across small of back, at times extending downward into posterior portion of pelvis, of thighs, and even to calves, with a feeling of stiffness and lameness, or swelling of back or lower extremities.
Sticking or sticking-pressing pain, at times slight, at times very sensitive, in one or other lumbar region, now in a small spot which is a simple sticking, now in a larger place, when it is chiefly pressing, either exactly in region of kidneys, or at times extending above or below, but especially outward, so that it extends around side of abdomen in front or to region of hips, sometimes also in spine and extending down to small of back, and region of bladder and groins, sometimes fine, sometimes dull ; sticking sometimes extends from region of kidneys straight forward into abdomen, and at times with a numb, paralyzed, bruised sensation, frequently returning and lasting a long time.
Pressive or tensive pains in region of loins and kidneys, with a feeling of stiffness and lameness, or swelling, in back and lower limbs (Kali carb.) without stiffness and lameness.
Tearing pulsating pain in right kidney.
A sticking-digging, or digging-tearing pain in one or other kidney region, as if it was suppurating ; < by deep pressure.
Burning and soreness in region of kidneys.
Burning stitches, single or several in succession, in region of loins and kidneys.
Much pain, soreness and tenderness in back, in region of kidneys. θ Rheumatism of knee.
Sensitiveness in region of kidneys so great that any jarring motion, riding in a wagon, jumping from it, was intolerable. θ Rheumatism.
After kidney complaints a foul, bitter taste, rush of blood to throat ; great appetite, hasty eating ; urine has reddish sediment.
Great urging, with pain in neck of bladder, with burning, scanty urine.
Cutting, constrictive pain in bladder.
Violent, cutting, tensive pain, deeply seated in left side of bladder, at last becoming a sticking, obliquely in female urethra, as if in its orifice, lasting a few minutes.
Painful cuttings in left side of region of bladder extend into urethra, coming from left kidney along course of ureter.
Drawing sticking pain in one or other side of bladder, extending down into female urethra, often arising in lumbar region and extending along course of ureters.
Burning pain in bladder, sometimes when it is full, sometimes when empty, soon after urinating, several times, frequently also in morning before urinating for first time.
Pain in bladder when moving.
Most violent burning and shooting in orifice of urethra, after climaxis ; æt. 50.
Urine bright yellow, with profuse mucous sediment.
Inflammatory red urine.
Blood red urine, which speedily becomes turbid and deposits a thick mucous and bright red, mealy sediment, slowly becoming clear, but always retaining its bright red color, with violent pains in kidneys.
Urine dark, turbid with copious sediment. θ Jaundice.
Urine contains a clear mucous sediment.
Urine very slow to flow, with much pain and pressure in region of bladder in front. θ Rheumatism in knee.
Urinary symptoms are improved by rest.
After urinating, a sensation in bladder, as if one must go again soon, or as if some urine remained behind.
With symptoms in urinary organs, pain in loins and hips.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Berb.]
Burning in urethra.
Smarting, burning pains in spermatic cord, with several stitches, now on one, now on other side.
Soft, pulpy swelling of spermatic cord, especially in lower portions, several times when walking, with at times drawing, burning, smarting, or tearing pains ; at times also when sitting, with pain extending down into testicles, especially epididymis.
Most excruciating pain extends along urethra into bladder, into testicle, which is drawn up on affected side.
Drawing pain in spermatic cord of right, frequently of left side, extending down into testicles, or up into abdominal ring.
Neuralgia and inflammation of spermatic cord, testicles and epididymis.
Penis hard and contracted all along upper part, bending it upward. θ With an old man.
Burning at very point of penis within canal. θ Kidney disease.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Berb.]
Complete want of pleasurable sensation during coition. θ Ovarian disease.
Sticking pains in female urethra, beginning in bladder.
Burning pain in female urethra during and after urinating.
Burning in urethra, along whole length of it.
Violent sticking in left side of abdomen, two fingers breadth from navel, extending in long stitches into left side of vagina ; smarting pain in vagina ; burning, violent pain and soreness in anus.
Sensation of burning and soreness in vagina, frequently very sensitive, especially in anterior portion, even extending to labia.
Intensely painful vagina ; burning, sore, as if excoriated.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Berb.]
Pulse slow and weak, or full, hard and rapid.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Berb.]
Great soreness and pain through entire back from sacrum to shoulders, greatly increased whenever patient performed any labor. θ Fistula in ano.
Tearing pain in posterior portion of iliac crest, usually only to one side, extending downward into gluteal muscles, or into bones.
Deep-seated, sensitive sticking pain in ilium of one or other side, an inch to an inch and a half from spine, extending obliquely inward towards sacrum.
If she stooped, lower part of back felt stiff, it was with difficulty she could stand up ; tearing when sitting, < when standing ; > in afternoon.
A feeling of warmth in lower part of back, and in small of back, as if lumbar region was asleep, extending down into sacrum, hips, and posterior portion of thighs.
Pressive-tensive, or pressing sensation in sacrum ; deep, internal when severe, with a feeling as if bones would be forced asunder ; < when sitting and lying.
Violent pain in sacrum. θ Hemorrhoids.
Pain in small of back ; < when sitting and lying in morning, when awaking. θ During menstruation.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Berb.]
Petechiæ, small and red, with white spots on forearm and backs of hands.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Berb.]
Pain in hips. θ Kidney disease.
Sensation in knees as if palsied, weary and beaten, after walking, and when arising from seat.
Left knee twice size of the other, very stiff, sore and painful. θ Rheumatism.
Great swelling, pain and stiffness, could not raise foot high enough to walk on rough ground, would catch his toe and fall. θ Rheumatism of knee.
   

NERVES. [36] [Berb.]
General relaxation, not inclined to do anything.
   

FEVER. [40] [Berb.]
Chilliness, with hot face, followed by heat with perspiration ; or burning heat in afternoon, increasing during night.
Typhoid and putrid fevers.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Berb.]
Muscular rheumatism in chest, lumbar region, and upper and lower limbs.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Berb.]
After riding much pain and great sense of weakness and trembling in region of kidneys, taking a long time to get over, sometimes days. θ Rheumatism of knees.
   

SKIN. [46] [Berb.]
Old yellow spots around navel peeling off.
Red spot on left eyelid, feels like a mosquito-bite, but swelling nearly closes eye ; next day other spots on face, behind ear, on neck ; third day on chin and nose, with itching and burning : in evening covered with small vesicles, oozing watery fluid.
Furuncles. θ Fistula in ano.
Herpes around anus.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Berb.]
Male, æt. 34 ; for years indigestion from chronic gastritis, reduced in weight, pale, discouraged ; after improvement by Lycop. ; rheumatism of knee.
An old woman, æt. 70 ; heartburn of thirty years standing.
